title: Staff Data Analyst - Compliance
description:
Our mission and customers: We are creating the freedom for SMEs to succeed by delivering Europe's leading finance workspace with banking at its core, augmented by financial tools. We are proud to be rated 4.8 on Trustpilot, based on 55,000+ reviews. Our culture puts customer satisfaction at the core of what we do, as proven by our Net Promoter Score of 75 (more about our culture here).

Our journey: Founded in 2017 by Alexandre and Steve, Qonto has grown to 1,600+ Qontoers serving over 600,000+ customers across 8 European countries. We have been profitable since 2023, and we are just getting started.

Our beliefs: We hire for skills and potential. With 80+ nationalities, 45% women, of which 56% of women in our leadership team, diversity isn't a program; It's who we are. We've built a discrimination-free hiring process because the best teams are built on merit.

AI at Qonto: AI is deeply embedded in how we work (here) - Every Qontoer gets unlimited access to the best AI tools. We want people who experiment without waiting for permission, push AI beyond the obvious, know when to trust it, and when to question it.

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


Join us as a Staff Data Analyst - Compliance to build the analytics foundations that power Qonto's compliance execution. You'll own a brand-new scope — monitoring KYC/KYB funnels, remediation campaigns, and financial exposure — working cross-functionally with Product, Ops, Risk & Compliance, and Internal Control, under the guidance of Alma, our Lead Data Analyst.

👩‍💻🧑‍💻 As a Data Analyst at Qonto, you will

  • Build compliance process monitoring from scratch: You'll build and own the data infrastructure that powers compliance monitoring at Qonto — from onboarding funnel analytics to remediation financial exposure — giving product, operations and compliance teams the self-service tools they need to make decisions without waiting on a data request.
  • Model and transform data with dbt: With the collaboration of Analytics Engineer Team, you'll build end-to-end transformation pipelines from source to consumption layer, keeping metric definitions clean and trusted by non-technical stakeholders.
  • Turn regulatory questions into self-service assets: You'll partner with Product, Ops, Risk & Compliance, and Internal Control to scope and ship analytical tools
  • Own the KYC/KYB funnel analytics end-to-end: You'll deliver insights from CS initiation through KYB validation — refusal reasons, document gaps, lead-time distributions — so teams can act on friction fast.
  • Track remediation campaigns and financial exposure: You'll measure MRR secured, at risk, or lost across active campaigns, with peak intensity in Q4 (budget season) and May–June (reforecast).

🤔 What you can expect

  • A greenfield, strategically critical scope: Qonto is under close regulatory scrutiny — you'll build analytics foundations that matter company-wide, not just for your team.
  • Senior, cross-functional exposure from day one: Product, Ops, Risk & Compliance, Internal Control — few DA roles give you this breadth of senior stakeholder access at this level.
  • Real ownership in the Modern Data Stack: You'll build in Omni and dbt with a high degree of autonomy — no legacy to untangle, just foundations to create.
  • A team where AI is a first-class tool: Unlimited access to AI tools (Claude, Cursor, and more) to evolve how you work, not just output more.

➡️ Your future manager

Your manager will be Alma, our Lead Data Analyst for Ops & Finance. Alma knows exactly what it takes to build an analytics function that actually changes decisions, and she'll push you to do the same.

Alma reports to Erwan, Director of Business Analytics who oversees the entire Analytics function and ensures alignment across teams.

🏅 About You

  • Compliance or regulated environment experience: You've worked analytically on KYC/KYB, AML, remediation, or similar regulatory/operational processes — and you know how to get credible with those stakeholders fast.
  • Self-service product mindset: You've designed dashboards and models for end-users to explore autonomously, adapting the same dataset from ops-level (daily SLA tracking) to exec-level (budget readouts).
  • Cross-functional stakeholder management: You've juggled competing analytical priorities across multiple teams — and you know how to scope clearly, push back when needed, and drive adoption.
  • Strong SQL and data modelling skills: You've built end-to-end transformation pipelines, enforced data quality, and made non-technical stakeholders trust your numbers.
  • AI-native workflow: You actively use AI tools to accelerate your analytics work — from data modelling to stakeholder communication — and you're genuinely curious about going further.
  • Language: Fluent in English.

title: Data Analyst Assistant
description:
About the role
 The Data Analyst Assistant role is central to our current engagement with a Dubai-based investment firm that requires precise data handling and clear visualization. This position provides the quantitative groundwork that allows our principals to form a view on complex corporate governance and strategy questions. We need an assistant who can organize messy data sets into logical structures that reveal the health and performance of a holding company.

About Arabian Private Holdings
 Arabian Private Holdings was founded on the principle that many critical business problems do not fit the traditional large-firm consulting model. A board facing a succession question or a family group weighing a capital injection does not need a team of twelve associates and a hundred-page methodology deck. They need experienced partners who can sit with a problem, form a rigorous view, and defend it. We take on a limited number of mandates to ensure that every client receives direct attention from the principals who are actually accountable for the outcome. Our work covers corporate strategy, governance, and operating model efficiency for some of the most significant family groups, listed corporations, and government entities in the region. We focus on clarity over complexity. We operate as a remote firm, choosing to prioritize the quality of our analysis and the strength of our relationships over traditional office overhead or aggressive growth targets.

What you will do
  • Collect and organize financial and operational data from various portfolio companies for a Dubai-based investment.
  • Clean and validate data sets to ensure accuracy before they are used in client presentations.
  • Build simple, effective spreadsheets that track performance indicators for large holding companies.
  • Assist in drafting reports that translate numbers into clear written arguments for our principals.
  • Monitor industry trends and perform basic market research to support ongoing strategic mandates.
  • Maintain internal records to ensure that historical client data is easily accessible and correctly categorized.
  • Prepare charts and graphs that simplify complex financial structures for board-level reviews.
  • Support the audit of corporate governance documents by cross-referencing quantitative findings with qualitative reports.


What we are looking for
  • A clear understanding of basic statistics and a logical approach to problem-solving.
  • Proficiency in spreadsheet software with an ability to manage large amounts of information without errors.
  • Strong written skills and the ability to explain what a set of numbers means in plain English.
  • Curiosity about how large corporations and family groups operate in different sectors.
  • Precision in your work, where you check your own calculations before submitting them for review.
  • A degree or ongoing studies in a quantitative field such as economics, finance, or mathematics.


How we work
 We operate as a fully remote firm, which means we rely on clear documentation and asynchronous communication. Because our work involves sensitive mandates for high-profile clients, we maintain a high standard of professional conduct and data security. You will work closely with a principal who provides direct mentorship and expects you to form your own view on the data you analyze. We do not value long hours for the sake of appearances. Instead, we focus on the rigor of the output and the clarity of the logic. This remote model allows us to hire individuals based on their intellectual capability rather than their physical location, ensuring we can provide the best possible advice to our clients.

What the role offers
  • A paid entry-level position with a competitive compensation package for the current market.
  • Direct exposure to high-level corporate strategy and governance mandates.
  • Mentorship from experienced principals who have managed some of the largest holding companies in the region.
  • The flexibility of a permanent, full-time role that is entirely remote.
  • Practical experience in forming a rigorous view on business performance and portfolio health.

title: Freiberufliche Lehrkraft (w/m/d) für Data Analytics
description:
Deine Rolle bei Karriere Tutor

Wir suchen engagierte und kompetente freiberufliche Dozierende (m/w/d) für Data Analytics, die den Kurs gemeinsam mit unserem Team im Rahmen von planbaren Einsätzen auf den Markt bringen und ausliefern. Bei Interesse an einem festangestellten Verhältnis verweisen wir auf unsere anderen Stellen. 

Deine Aufgaben:

  • Bereitstellung von Unterrichtsmaterial für den genannten Kurs.
  • Fachlich fundierte und praxisnahe Vermittlung von Lerninhalten.
  • Kurz- und mittelfristige Übernahme von Lehrveranstaltungen.
  • Betreuung und Unterstützung von Teilnehmenden.
Die Rahmenbedingungen dazu: 
  • Kursdauer: 4 Wochen 
  • Liveunterricht: Montag bis Donnerstag: 08:30 - 13:00 Uhr 
  • Betreutes Lernen: Montag bis Donnerstag: 13:00 - 16:45 Uhr und Freitag 08:30 - 13:00 Uhr. 
    Dafür stellst du passende Materialien bereit, eine Anwesenheit in dieser Zeit ist nicht vorgesehen. 
  • Testphase: 3 Testdurchläufe sind zunächst geplant


Dein Profil

  • Nachweisbare Qualifikation als Data Analyst, Data Scientist oder vergleichbar.
  • Relevante Berufserfahrung in der praktischen Anwendung der Techniken und Methoden eines Data Analyst.
  • Du bringst vorhandenes Unterrichtsmaterial für die Auslieferung der Maßnahme mit oder bist motiviert, dieses eigenständig zu entwickeln.
  • Praxiserfahrung in der Erwachsenenbildung. 
  • Freude an der Wissensvermittlung und didaktisches Geschick. 
  • Kommunikationsstärke, Empathie, technische Versiertheit. 
  • Selbstständige Arbeitsweise und Flexibilität, 
  • Sicherer Umgang mit digitalen Tools und Lernplattformen. 
  • Deutschkenntnisse (mindestens C1)

Wenn wir deine Neugierde geweckt haben und du an einer Kooperation mit uns interessiert bist, freuen wir uns über deine Kontaktaufnahme und Zusendung deines Dozierenden-Profils samt Nachweisen.
